```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(readxl)
```


```{r}
cell_cycle_analysis<- read_xlsx(path="data/cell_cycle_analysis.xlsx")
melted_data<- cell_cycle_analysis %>% reshape2::melt(id.vars= c("cell_line", "Gene" ,"Guide", "Replicate"))



Gene_Guide_order <- c("NT_NT", 
                      "MYC_Guide_1",
                      "MYC_Guide_2",
                      "SNHG15_Guide_1",
                      "SNHG15_Guide_2",
                      "SNHG15_Guide_3",
                      "SNHG16_Guide_1",
                      "SNHG16_Guide_2",
                      "SNHG16_Guide_3")



melted_data$Gene_Guide <- interaction(melted_data$Gene, melted_data$Guide, sep = "_")
melted_data$Gene_Guide <- factor(melted_data$Gene_Guide, levels = Gene_Guide_order)

# draw data for A549 Cell Line
melted_data %>% filter(cell_line=="A549") %>% droplevels() %>% ggplot( aes(x = Gene_Guide, 
                        y = value, 
                        fill = Gene)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_point(aes(y = value), 
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
             color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Gene + GuideRNA", 
       y = "Percentage of cells", 
       fill = "Gene", 
       title = "Cell Cycle Distribution by Gene and GuideRNA\nA549") +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = Gene_Guide),              # compare by guide
    label = "p.signif",              # show significance stars
    method = "t.test",               # or "wilcox.test"
    ref.group = "NT_NT",                # compare everything to NT
    hide.ns = FALSE,                   # hide non-significant
    symnum.args = list(
    cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
    symbols   = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))
ggsave(filename = "A549_three_phases_cell_cycle.svg", dpi = 1000, width = 20, height = 10, unit="cm")
```

```{r}
# both cell lines, S phase only

melted_data %>% filter(variable=="S")%>% droplevels() %>% ggplot( aes(x = Gene_Guide, 
                        y = value, 
                        fill = Gene)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_point(aes(y = value), 
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
             color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_line) +
  labs(x = "Gene + GuideRNA", 
       y = "Percentage of cells", 
       fill = "Gene", 
       title = "Percentage of Cells at S Phase") +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = Gene_Guide),              # compare by guide
    label = "p.signif",              # show significance stars
    method = "t.test", # or "wilcox.test"
    method.args = list(var.equal = FALSE),
    ref.group = "NT_NT",                # compare everything to NT
    hide.ns = FALSE,                   # hide non-significant
    symnum.args = list(
    cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
    symbols   = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) 

ggsave(filename = "percentage_S_phase.svg", dpi = 1000, width = 20, height = 10, unit="cm")
```


```{r}
order <- c("G1","S", "G2/M" )
facet_order <- c("NT", "MYC", "SNHG15", "SNHG16")

summary_plot <- melted_data %>%
  filter(cell_line == "A549") %>%
  group_by(Gene, Guide, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    sd   = sd(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Gene,Guide) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = mean / sum(mean) * 100,
    prop_sd = sd / sum(mean) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # make variable a factor in the desired order
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = order)) %>%
  group_by(Gene,Guide) %>%
  arrange(variable) %>%   # now respects factor order
  mutate(
    cumsumValue = cumsum(prop),
    min=cumsumValue-prop_sd,
    max=cumsumValue+prop_sd
  )


summary_plot <- summary_plot %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("G2/M","S","G1")), Gene = factor(Gene, levels = facet_order))

summary_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Guide, y = prop, fill = variable)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = min, ymax = max),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(~Gene, scales = "free_x", space="free_x") +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggsci::scale_fill_aaas(name="Cell Cycle\nPhase") +
 ggtitle("Cell Cycle Analysis\nA549")+
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = summary_plot %>%
      filter(Guide == "NT", variable %in% c("G1")) %>%
      pull(prop),
    linetype = "dashed")




ggsave(filename = "cell_cycle_triple_A549_new.svg", width=15, height = 10, unit="cm")

```
